blurb: Guests fish aboard a custom 48' high speed vessel "Island Bound" for full day offshore trips targeting cod, haddock, shark, and giant tuna, or half day inshore trips for striped bass and bluefish. The boat accommodates up to 20 passengers and is equipped with modern electronics, comfortable seating, heat, enclosed head, and bunks. Trips include rods, bait, filleting, and icing of the catch.
extraNote: Fuel surcharge may be added if fuel prices climb · Tipping mate customary at 15-20% of charter fee · Captain confirms charter date by call or email before payment · Wentworth Marina, "Island Bound" located on "A" dock, slip #1 at bottom of ramp · May through November
